protocol.execution: serial, separate fresh browser process per backend/public trial and separate fresh process for each diagnostic; alternate backend order between repetitions
protocol.network: uncompressed no-store HTTP on loopback; no network throttling; cold browser cache, potentially warm OS filesystem cache
protocol.timing: performance.now around each individual call; nearest-rank percentiles over all equally weighted fixed cases and repetitions; zero-resolution samples retained
protocol.firstResponse: Dictionary fetch starts after harness navigation. Startup after dictionary fetch includes wrapper import, feature detection if selected, core loading/compile, snapshot/transport, init, first kensaku query, RegExp construction, and all document matches.
protocol.regex: new RegExp(pattern, u) constructor time measured separately from first test and document matching; engines may cache compilation and defer work to test()
protocol.memory: performance.memory observations where available; no forced GC, no process RSS or total Wasm GC attribution. Values are not comparable across browsers and are not an adoption criterion.

compression.aggregation: sum of individually compressed HTTP resources; no shared compression context

sizes.scope: Unminified release executable code plus public ESM wrapper and required feature probe. Type declarations, licenses, HTTP headers, demo, source maps and dictionary are excluded from code totals. Dictionary is identical and reported separately.
